title: This startup’s metal stacks could help solve AI’s massive heat problem
description: Alloy Enterprises has developed a new additive manufacturing technique that can improve liquid cooling performance while bringing it to new parts of the server rack.
author: Tim De Chant

title: Google gets the US government’s green light to acquire Wiz for $32B
description: Google announced its intent to acquire cloud security company Wiz in March and the deal is now on track to close in early 2026.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: SoftBank, OpenAI launch new joint venture in Japan as AI deals grow ever more circular
description: SoftBank's joint venture with OpenAI that will localize and sell the AI company's enterprise tech to companies in Japan. And the first customer of this joint venture is going to be SoftBank itself.
author: Ram Iyer

title: Google Maps bakes in Gemini to improve navigation and hands-free use
description: Google is now baking Gemini into Maps to let users ask it questions while driving, improve navigation, and do more with the app.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Former Meta employees launch Sandbar, a smart ring that takes voice notes and controls music
description: A raft of voice-based hardware devices have emerged, aimed at companionship, productivity, or personal growth. These include card-shaped devices from Plaud and Pocket; pendants from Friend, Limitless, and Taya; and a wristband from Bee, which is now part of Amazon. Now, two former Meta employees who worked on interface design have launched Sandbar, a startup […]
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Former Meta employees launch Stream, a smart ring that takes voice notes and controls music
description: The company calls the ring "a mouse for voice" because it can take notes, help you interact with an AI assistant, and let you control music.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Goldman Sachs doubles down on MoEngage in new round to fuel global expansion
description: MoEngage already has customers across 75 countries, with North America being its biggest business driver.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: NVIDIA, Qualcomm join U.S., Indian VCs to help build India’s next deep tech startups
description: Qualcomm Ventures has joined six Indian venture firms, collectively adding more than $850 million to boost India’s deep-tech ecosystem.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: Amazon sends legal threats to Perplexity over agentic browsing
description: Amazon won't allow agents on its site that don't identify themselves as such. Perplexity is not pleased.
author: Julie Bort, Rebecca Bellan

title: People Inc. forges AI licensing deal with Microsoft as Google traffic drops
description: People Inc. signs an AI licensing deal with Microsoft, which will use its media content in Copilot.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Rivian creates another spinoff company called Mind Robotics
description: It's the second time this year Rivian has spun out a new company, after it created micromobility startup Also in March.
author: Sean O'Kane

title: Google’s AI Mode gets new agentic capabilities to help book event tickets and beauty appointments
description: For example, you can ask "find me 2 cheap tickets for the Shaboozey concert coming up. prefer standing floor tickets." AI Mode will then search across multiple websites to find real-time ticket options that meet your specific requests.
author: Aisha Malik

title: Sora is now available on Android in the US, Canada, and other regions
description: The Sora app is now available for Android users in the US, Canada, and Japan, among other regions.
author: Lauren Forristal

title: Shopify says AI traffic is up 7x since January, AI-driven orders are up 11x
description: Shopify says AI-driven traffic to its online stores is up 7x since January, and orders from AI search are up 11x.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Anthropic projects $70B in revenue by 2028: Report
description: The Information reports that Anthropic expects to generate as much as $70 billion in revenue and $17 billion in cash flow in 2028. The growth projections are fueled by rapid adoption of Anthropic’s business products, a person with knowledge of the company’s financials said.
author: Rebecca Bellan
